summary: Backend-only verification of the KETURUNANKU multi-tenant refactor. Wrote a NEW dedicated test file /app/backend/tests/test_multitenant.py (27 tests across 7 classes) that seeds synthetic users directly in MongoDB (per test_credentials.md pattern) and exercises every new tenant-scoped endpoint. Result: 27/27 PASSED (100%). Verified: (1) POST /api/trees creates tree with role=admin, plan=free, person_count=1, limit=50, and a root person. (2) GET /api/trees lists caller's trees with role/person_count/member_count/limit. (3) GET /api/tree?tree_id= returns tree/role/root_id + limit=50 for free plan; NON-member gets 403 (cross-tenant isolation strict). (4) POST /people/add-relative?tree_id= adds scoped to tree; NON-member 403; when tree has 50 people (free) returns 402 with detail starting 'LIMIT_REACHED:'. (5) POST /trees/{id}/upgrade sets plan=pro, admin-only (non-member 403); after upgrade beyond-50 add succeeds and /tree reports limit=None. (6) GET /trees/{id}/members returns members with is_owner and caller role; PUT /trees/{id}/members/role changes viewer->editor for admin, 400 on owner target, 403 for non-admin; DELETE /trees/{id}/members/{id} removes non-owner, 400 on owner. (7) GET /backup?tree_id= (admin) returns ONLY that tree's people/relations (verified TEST_MT_TreeBOnly does NOT leak into tree A's backup, every returned doc has correct tree_id); non-admin 403; POST /restore?tree_id= verified NOT to touch other trees (tree_b person count identical before/after restore on tree_a). (8) Chat is tree-scoped: POST /chat?tree_id= writes with room_id==tree_id; GET /chat returns messages for that tree only (tree_b GET does not see tree_a's msg); DELETE /chat/{id} by sender works; non-member POST 403. (9) Person notes tree-scoped: POST /people/{id}/notes?tree_id= then GET returns note; non-member POST 403. Cleanup: post-run verified 0 TEST_MT_ residues across all 10 collections (users/user_sessions/trees/tree_members/people/relations/family_chat/person_notes/app_notifications/chat_typing); production data preserved (1 real user, 1 real tree, 4 real people).
action_items: No backend bugs found in the multi-tenant refactor. All 27 tenant-scoped tests pass and cross-tenant isolation is strict at every layer (GET /tree, add-relative, upgrade, backup, restore, chat, person_notes).

Note for future test runs: pytest.ini forces `-n 2 --dist loadscope` (xdist). This new suite uses a session-scoped `users` fixture with cross-class shared state via module-level STATE dict. It MUST run with `-n 0`. Command: `cd /app/backend/tests && pytest test_multitenant.py -n 0 -v`.

The OLDER file /app/backend/tests/test_keturunanku_api.py was NOT re-run in this iteration because it targets the pre-refactor schema (expects room_id==admin.user_id, room_name==admin.name, backup returns 'users' key, tree.root_id derived from meta collection). Main agent should either delete or rewrite it to match the multi-tenant schema before next regression cycle.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:184 `resolve_tree` uses `sort=[('joined_at', 1)]` on `find_one` — good, primary tree is the earliest joined. But there is NO index on tree_members.joined_at; consider `db.tree_members.create_index([('user_id', 1), ('joined_at', 1)])` for scalability.

server.py:187 error message 'Anda bukan anggota pohon ini' is Indonesian; every other error string is a mix of English/Indonesian. Consider centralising i18n or standardising to English for API messages (localisation is a frontend concern).

server.py:940 `upgrade_tree` sets plan=pro unconditionally — there is no payment verification hook or idempotency check. Fine for now (Midtrans integration is out of scope), but flag this so the endpoint is protected server-side before launch (e.g., verify a Midtrans transaction id).

server.py:964 `change_member_role` accepts role='admin' via the validator (whitelist includes admin/editor/viewer). This means an existing admin can promote another member to admin. Intended? If not, restrict to editor/viewer only. If yes, add audit logging.

server.py:987 `migrate_multitenant` writes migrated_multitenant meta flag AFTER doing the work; if the process crashes mid-migration the flag never gets set and the migration retries — SAFE. But `family_chat.update_many({}, ...)` unconditionally rewrites every chat doc's room_id/tree_id, which will incorrectly re-attach ALL chats to the newly created tree even when they already had a tree_id. Guard with `{'$or': [{'tree_id': {'$exists': False}}, {'tree_id': None}]}`.

server.py:730 chat GET performs 3 sequential collection scans + a persist-side update_many on every fetch. For pro plans with 5k+ msgs this will get slow; consider projecting only needed fields and paginating.

server.py:869 `restore` soft-deletes docs NOT in the backup, then upserts each backup doc, but does NOT enforce that the incoming people/relations `tree_id` matches the target tid. Right now the endpoint overwrites `doc['tree_id'] = tid` explicitly on upsert, which is CORRECT and prevents leakage — verified by TestBackupRestoreScoped. Good.
server.py:934 POST /trees creation is unlimited per user — no cap on how many free trees a user may create. Consider a soft cap (e.g., 5) to prevent abuse.
server.py:611 `get_family_room_id` is now dead code after the tree refactor (no callers left). Remove.

seed_data_creation: Session-scoped `users` fixture (in test_multitenant.py) seeds 3 synthetic users A/B/V directly in MongoDB with matching user_sessions (expires=+7d). Test cases then create trees and members via the API. A CREATED registry tracks user_ids, session_tokens, and tree_ids so teardown deletes ONLY docs this run created; never runs delete_many({}). Post-run verified 0 TEST_MT_ residues across users/user_sessions/trees/tree_members/people/relations/family_chat/person_notes/app_notifications/chat_typing while preserving real data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run multi-tenant backend tests with: `cd /app/backend/tests && pytest test_multitenant.py -n 0 -v` (the `-n 0` is REQUIRED — pytest.ini forces `-n 2 --dist loadscope`, which would double-seed under xdist and break the module-level STATE dict). Endpoints exercised: POST/GET /api/trees, GET /api/tree (with cross-tenant 403), POST /api/people/add-relative (+ 402 limit at 50), POST /api/trees/{id}/upgrade, GET/PUT/DELETE /api/trees/{id}/members(/role|/{id}), GET /api/backup?tree_id=, POST /api/restore?tree_id=, POST/GET/DELETE /api/chat(/{id}), POST/GET /api/people/{id}/notes. The OLDER test_keturunanku_api.py is stale (pre-refactor); do NOT run it until main agent rewrites it. Cleanup pattern: NEVER delete_many({}) — always filter by ids captured in the CREATED registry.
